Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Clearbridge Health (post-call recap & clarifying Qs)

Hi Lena / Tom — great to meet you on the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Action: We'll start the SIG questionnaire you requested. I attached our Redwood SIG template to make it easier to map answers to your vendor process (Redwood_SIG_template.xlsx).
- Timeline: you mentioned a 2-week target to complete; that works on our side.
- Current posture: we confirmed on the call that Redwood has SOC 2 Type II (report available), supports encryption at-rest/in-transit, and offers a BAA for HIPAA-covered workloads. I'll pull the SOC 2 report and our security summary into a single packet.

To help our security and legal teams complete the SIG correctly, could you confirm a couple clarifying items from the call: 
1) Data scope: Will Clearbridge be sending PHI into Redwood-hosted endpoints (i.e., patient-identifiable data)? If so, is there a preferred data retention policy we should be aware of?
2) Environment: Are you planning to use our hosted Redwood API (shared tenant), or do you require Dedicated/Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) for PHI?
3) Integrations & data flow: Are there any third-party systems (analytics, transcription vendors) that will also receive the data from Redwood?

If you prefer, we can propose a 30-minute follow-up with one of our security engineers (Jonas) to go through any technical questions.

Thanks — I'll coordinate internally and send a draft SIG back for your review as soon as we have the initial pass.

Best,
Camila Reyes

Thanks Camila — appreciated the recap and the template. A few quick answers and notes from our side: 

- Data scope: Yes, Clearbridge WILL send PHI into vendor endpoints for the pilot (patient notes and IDs). We will need Redwood to sign a BAA.
- Retention: Our default policy is 90 days for raw inputs, 1 year for processed outputs, but we can scope this down for the pilot. We require the vendor to support configurable retention/auto-delete.
- Deployment: For now we prefer using a Private deployment (VPC) option if feasible; otherwise Dedicated with network isolation. We can discuss details during the security call.
- Third parties: We plan to pipe outputs to our internal analytics pipeline (in-house) — no external 3rd-party processors at this time.

Attached a short security overview for Clearbridge so you have context (Clearbridge_Security_Overview.pdf). Our procurement lead (Tom) will coordinate contract/BAA next steps. Please send the SOC 2 report and your completed SIG draft when available.

Lena Parker
Head of Information Security
Clearbridge Health
